name: Genesis
moduleSystem: classic-scripts (shared global scope) — ES modules deferred until inline onclick handlers are rebound

modules.desc: The single mutable-state container (GS). All transient app/creator state (CGEN/BARDO/CG_DRAG/FATE_CTX/SEED/ORC) lives here as GS.* — greppable, one home. `var` so GS is on window (inline on* handlers need it). U stays in world.state. Established 2026-06-20 per docs/SCALING.md.
Pronoun sets for character creation + DM narration. Player picks a set; stored on the soul/character; surfaced to the DM in the handoff. pronounSet(id) expands to subj/obj/poss/reflex.

The SCRIPT for the guided Genesis ritual (carved out of genesis.html 2026-06-22): the ordered world-genesis beats (STAGES, aliased WORLDBEATS), the spirit-guide narration (GUIDE), and the Life-chain step metadata (LIFE_STEP). Plain data read at call-time by world.play (world beats) + creator.* (the guided new-game passage).
XGE biography tables + bg/class why-prose.
Per-species name pools.
World/setting tables (T) + the player-facing Fragment oracle veil (FRAG), row-aligned to T.
Starting-state tables: factions/pressures/the uncanny/entry (SS), concretization map (SS_CONC), opening-bundle fallbacks (EB).
Layer-1 mechanical char data (abilities, classes, species, backgrounds) + guided-Sheet tooltips (TIP).

Curated SRD 5.2.1/2024-PHB class data the guided creator walks: skill choices (n-from-list), starting-equipment packages (A/B/gold), and L1 spellcasting (cantrip/spell counts + list + ability). Plus faction-proximity affinity (METHOD_KIND maps a faction's Method→kind; CLASS_FACTION_AFFINITY tilts which local power a class is born near — docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md step 4). Transcribed+verified from Reference/SRD-Data/classes.md. Added 2026-06-21.

Cantrip + level-1 spell picker surface (name/level/school/classes/flavor). GENERATED by build/gen-spells-slim.py from Reference/SRD-Data/spells.json — never hand-edit. file:// loads it as a <script> global. Added 2026-06-21.

Levels 1-20 advancement for all 12 base classes: proficiency bonus, features (full SRD text embedded), spell slots / cantrips / prepared counts (full/half/pact), and class resource scalers (rage, sneak attack, sorcery points, etc.). The load-bearing data for leveling (docs/ADVANCEMENT.md). GENERATED by build/gen-class-progression.py from Reference/SRD-Data/classes.md — never hand-edit; the parser validates parsed spell-slot grids against canonical matrices. L1 reconciles with data/srd-creator.js. Added 2026-06-21.

Canon Wandering Souls — Adam's hand-made characters that ship as source and are seeded into every roster (world.state.seedCanonSouls). End-users' banked souls stay local; the roster is the union. Replaces the old one-off ROBIN_SEED.
Dice, table lookup, id, pick.
Table-roll primitives: rollTbl (flat/bell + mod), fragAt (FRAG veil), ebRoll (opening-bundle), concretize (uncanny roll-chain).

Starting-state roll-chains: faction/pressure rollers, the Entry bridge (entrySeeds/pickTension/rollEntry incl. faction proximity via factionKind/rollFactionProximity), and the ssFactionTurn web-tick. Writes to the world ledger at call-time.
Lazy deterministic hex substrate (docs/SPATIAL-MODEL.md): hash-terrain + axial geometry + node placement. renderHexMap (the SVG paint) stays in the app until the world/render carve.

The live consumable resource economy (docs/EVENT-CONTRACT.md + docs/ADVANCEMENT.md): derives current-vs-max HP / spell slots / pact slots / class pools (Rage, Bardic Inspiration, Channel Divinity, Focus, Sorcery Points, Action Surge) from CLASS_PROGRESSION, lazily inits current=max on the sheet, and owns every mutator (applyHpDelta/spendSlot/spendResource/restRecover) the DM events dispatch to. resourceDigest feeds dmDigest.

Persistence + the World Spine: localStorage universe (loadU/saveU), in-world clock, the World State Ledger (append-only), the node-graph map, and additive legacy-save migration. The live mutable globals U + SEED stay app-owned; these read/write them at call-time.

The relational entity store (docs/CODEX.md): NPC/Location/Item/Faction records with rolled (verbatim) + fields (player-safe) + dm (DM-only) + typed links[] (wikilinks) + status{known,soft,at,condition}. Two-tier lifecycle: SOFT entities are a recontextualizable pool (codexRecontextualize preserves the rolled soul, reassigns context); the player TOUCHING one locks it to canon forever (codexContact; recontextualize refuses on hard records). codexDigest = all-seeing DM slice; codexPlayerView = knowledge-gated sanitized projection. Written only via codex_* events in world.dm; ensureCodex migrates gazetteer/factions in (idempotent, non-destructive). Phase 1 of CODEX.md.

The Saga: a character's most significant entities (NPCs/enemies/factions/places/threads), derived + ranked from the world ledger + gazetteer + faction web by stake × frequency × recency. computeSaga(w,c) reads; refreshSaga(w,c) persists onto c.saga. The dead PC's Saga is what the 14 bardo vision-rolls act on (docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md, build step 1). Added 2026-06-21.

The death→rebirth loop (docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md). Step 2: the bardo gap — rollBardoGap() is a 0–49 in-world-day bell roll (triangular, mode ~3–4 weeks); bardoGap(w,[days]) advances the world clock by the gap and turns the faction web once per elapsed week. Step 3: the 14 vision-rolls — bardoVisions(w,c) dreams 7 peaceful + 7 wrathful outcomes over the dead PC's Saga (rollVision mutates faction clocks / NPC + place fate / threads via applyVision, writes the truth to the ledger, surfaces a Fragment to the player; VISION_OUTCOMES is draft flavor pending an authored table). runBardo(w,c) orchestrates refreshSaga→gap→visions, storing c.visions. Step 5: corpse + loot decay — a fallen PC's body+effects persist (set at death); corpseStatus(w,c) decays fresh→disturbed→gone by elapsed in-world days vs the body's CORPSE_CONTEXTS; corpsesAt(w,node) finds recoverable bodies; claimCorpse(w,c,taker) transfers the haul. Layer 2 (query/logic; only L1/L2 deps). Added 2026-06-21.

The world-facing renders (DOM): the world panel, the hex map SVG, the route map, the ledger, the opening, powers, the start screen, and the universe shelf. Creator renders (renderBardo/renderCharge) live with the creator domain.

Track-B compiled-tables dice engine: CT (reads window.GENESIS_TABLES from tables.js), rollExpr (flat/bell/mixed dice strings), rollTable (roll a compiled table by id). Distinct from engine.tables, which rolls the inline-data tables.

Segment walk-roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollUrbanWalk(opts) picks a topology (16 graph-shape pacing grammars), builds the segment graph, rolls each node's segment sub-table (dedup+overflow), encounter, and scene frame from the compiled tables (row[5] cells), and returns the walk as a data structure (segments=nodes, transitions=edges). Ported from the Obsidian 'Urban Procedure v3.1' Templater; no file/canvas output.

Dungeon walk-roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollDungeonWalk(opts): 12 topologies, depth-budgeted loot, affinity-filtered boss/revelation (by rolled Myth Seed) → dungeon data structure (rooms=nodes, doors=edges). Ported from the Obsidian 'Dungeon Procedure v4.2'. Reuses engine.walk generics.

Wilderness leg-walk roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollWildernessWalk(opts): a linear journey of travel legs (biome can shift) + an arrival, each leg an encounter + travel texture → journey data structure (legs=nodes, route=edges). Authored from the wilderness table set (no source generator). Reuses engine.walk generics.

Quest-hook roller (docs/SYNTHESIS-CONTRACT.md). rollQuestHook({environment}) → raw hook material (destination flavor, macguffin, complication, urgency clock, questgiver-avoidance, pitch) bound to a prepped environment; questgiver identity left for the synthesis pass to assign. Reuses engine.walk's walkPick.

Prep-bundle assembler (docs/SYNTHESIS-CONTRACT.md) — the deterministic pre-step of the synthesis pass. assemblePrepBundle({world,tier,environments}) fires the multi-environment walk rollers, binds a quest hook to each, and gathers ledger context from the live world → the input bundle the staged synthesis prompts consume. prepBundleSummary() → the cheap Stage-1 view. No LLM.

The CODEX rollers (Phases 2+5; docs/CODEX.md §2) — the engine mints the atoms. rollNPC()/rollPlace()/rollItem()/rollBuildingInterior() chain the compiled npc-*/place-*/plot-item/plot-lock/building-interior tables (via rollTable) into a codexAdd-ready payload: `rolled` (raw dice verbatim), a player-safe `fields` glance-read, and DM-only `dm` levers; items carry a `source` pointer (§8b). They do NOT write the world — prep/the DM emit codex_add events. The AI assigns final meaning + wires links.

The Critical-Magnitude engine (docs/CRIT-MAGNITUDE.md §1, §4) — a nat 20/1 demands a second d20 (the magnitude die). rollCritMagnitude(natural,{magnitude}) maps the band → a lens count, draws that many DISTINCT lenses from the compiled mythic-success/failure-lenses (d12), and routes the row-1 'a place is transformed/scarred' lens into the Myth suite (rolls myth-seeds). Returns an atom payload only (rolled dice + lens vectors); never writes the world — the DM narrates, then emits a crit_outcome event (world.dm) to canonize a Mythic result to the Ledger.

The dice visual engine — one tumble-then-settle animation (dieRoll) + the spice 'juice' (diceSpice) for every die in the game. Context adapters (animateDie/bardoDieFx/bardoFx) delegate here. Generic + DOM-only so all layers call down into it.
The Oracle tab — filter/roll any compiled table, with the spice chip. ORC is the tab's local state.
App chrome: showTab (panel switch + per-tab render dispatch) and toast (transient notice). toast is called by world.state's reveal().
Ability-score logic: 4d6-drop, roll/assign/best, swap + drag-drop, background ASI, and the derived-stat calc (HP/AC/PP/saves). abilMod lives here.
The Life chain (Xanathar-style): table lookups, person descriptions, origins/path/events beats, the headline, and seedFromLife (writes life NPCs/threads to the ledger).
The manual charge-sheet UI (Layer-1 guided sheet): bind/cancel, chips, pick, and renderCharge.
The spirit-guide guided creator flow — the bardo state machine, beat helpers, dice FX, name rolls, and renderBardo. The mutable BARDO state stays app-owned.
Wandering Souls roster (read/bank/remove/render) + the species name generators. Canon souls come from data.souls-canon; this manages the live roster.

World-flow orchestration: the world-genesis ritual (startGenesis/rollStage/rollTriad/bindWorld), session + exploration loop (beginSession/explore/passTime/enterWorld), spawn (rollCharacter), and destroy.

The death entry + bardo passage (REWORKED 2026-06-21, Death & Rebirth step 7): killCharacter stamps the in-world time of death (c.fellWhen) + writes the fall as canon, openBardo runs runBardo (world.rebirth: gap drift + 14 visions) and renderBardoPassage reveals the vision Fragments to the player, closeBardo rolls a brand-new successor. The legacy d20 spawn-back is retired.
DM export — assembles the character + full world/scene handoff text (state, time, location, recent transitions) for the AI DM, with a clipboard fallback.

Session-Prep state (docs/SESSION-PREP.md #3+#5): startPrep assembles the bundle + binds each environment to a SOFT 'rumored frontier' node (soft edge = the quest hook); applyPrep enriches frontiers from the DM's synthesis overlays + writes soft new-canon; lockOnContact flips soft→hard on entry (Charter §8.4); prepHandoff/copyPrepHandoff export the staged bundle for the Bridge. Recycle/debt for unvisited prep.

The DM Bridge client + the EVENT-CONTRACT runtime. dmDigest()/sendTurn/pollResponse/applyResponse run the turn→response handshake against dev/dm-bridge.py; applyEvent(w,e) dispatches typed EVENT-CONTRACT.md events to the real mutators (the DM never writes U). Dev/test harness per docs/DM-BRIDGE.md; the runtime is reused by ADVANCEMENT/DIFFICULTY.

Entry point — the carve is complete: all logic + flow data now live in src/** and data/**. genesis.html holds the DOM, styles, the <script> load order, and a boot tail (let U=loadU(); migrateAll(); render/showTab). The 'owns *' is now just the app-owned universe handle U + the inline onclick contract that keeps module functions global.

notes: Classic scripts share one global scope: function decls -> window (inline onclick works); top-level const -> shared global lexical env (cross-file refs resolve at call-time). Load data before logic before main. Pass 2 (2026-06-20) carved the data layer: world-tables (T+FRAG), starting-state (SS/SS_CONC/EB), species-backgrounds (ABIL/ABIL_LABEL/CLASSES/SPECIES/BACKGROUNDS/TIP). Pass 3 (2026-06-20) began logic-by-domain with the engine: tables (rollTbl/fragAt/ebRoll/concretize), world-gen (faction/pressure/entry rollers + ssFactionTurn), hexmap (geometry + terrain); renderHexMap (SVG paint) stayed in app for the world/render carve. Next: src/creator/ (cg* char genesis, bardo* spirit guide, names logic — abilMod still in app), src/world/ (persistence U, render, ledger/clock/map), src/ui/ (showTab, toast, oracle).
